mentions.name: Scout for LoL
mentions.description: This match tracker for League of Legends posts Discord notifications when someone starts or ends a game, complete with a preview image. All games are saved to a datalake, and users can create competitions or scheduled reports over their community's matches. In development for ~4-5 years.
mentions.source_excerpt:
My pet project is this match tracker for League of Legends: https://scout-for-lol.com

Essentially it posts notifications to Discord when someone starts/ends a game with a pretty image.

All your games are saved to a datalake and you can create competitions or scheduled reports over your community's matches.
